page.page_subtitle: 面向户外服装、鞋材、软质箱包与柔性防护的面料应用。
page.rail_end_card_description: 告诉我们使用场景、功能要求和期望的手感，一起确定合适的面料。

products.name: 户外服装
products.image_alt: 雾中山野徒步的户外服装使用场景
products.card_summary: 用于冲锋衣、夹克、滑雪服、水域披风等户外服装。围绕风雨、运动出汗和反复穿着，兼顾防护、排湿与耐用表现。
products.detail_body: 专业户外优先考虑 OTTER；更侧重日常穿着与柔软手感的款式，也可从 RAYO 选材。

products.name: 轻户外服装
products.image_alt: 城市街区中穿着浅色轻外套的日常出行场景
products.card_summary: 用于轻户外夹克、防晒衣、垂钓披风等，适合日常出行、周末徒步与长时间户外活动。在所需防护的基础上，兼顾排湿、柔软手感与穿着舒适。
products.detail_body: 以 RAYO 为主要选材方向；对风雨防护或持续使用有更高要求的款式，可结合 OTTER 开发。

products.name: 户外鞋材
products.image_alt: 雨后林间步道上的户外鞋穿着近景
products.card_summary: 用于徒步鞋、户外休闲鞋等鞋面与内衬材料。根据穿着环境和鞋体结构，考虑防水透湿、反复弯折与摩擦，以及贴合后的支撑和脚感。
products.detail_body: 以 OTTER 为选材方向，结合鞋面、内衬和复合结构开发。面料性能与成鞋表现分别验证。

products.name: 软质箱包
products.image_alt: 旅途中背包与软质旅行箱的携行场景
products.card_summary: 用于背包、旅行袋与软质旅行箱。针对装载、搬运和户外使用中的摩擦、雨水及局部防护需求，选择外层面料与加强结构。
products.detail_body: OTTER 用于外层防护，KAIS 用于需要防割或局部加强的部位。可按包体、底部和受力位置分别选材。

products.name: 柔性防护服装与配件
products.image_alt: 柔性防护背心、手套与材料样片的应用示意
products.card_summary: 面向防割、防刺需求，为防护服装、手套及需要加强防护的部位开发柔性材料。结合使用部位与活动要求，选择材料和复合结构。
products.detail_body: 整片防护与局部加强，对材料厚度、柔软度和结构的要求不同。按具体样品与使用条件开展测试。

translations.为户外服装、轻户外穿着与柔性防护产品选择面料。: Fabric choices for outdoor clothing, everyday outdoor wear and flexible protection.
translations.告诉我们使用场景、功能要求和期望的手感，一起确定合适的面料。: Tell us where your product will be used, the functions it needs and the feel you want. We can help identify a suitable fabric.
translations.从徒步、登山到日常出行，外层服装需要应对风雨，也要让运动产生的湿气及时排出。根据: From hiking and mountaineering to everyday outings, outerwear needs weather protection and moisture transfer during activity. Balance protection, moisture management, durability and feel around the intended use.
translations.专业户外更看重复杂环境中的持续表现；轻户外则在满足所需功能的同时，更注重柔软手感: Technical outdoor products prioritise sustained performance in demanding conditions. Everyday outdoor products meet their functional needs with greater emphasis on softness and wearing comfort.
translations.日常出行、周末户外或长时间垂钓，面料既要满足防晒与排湿需要，也要柔软、易于活动，: For daily outings, weekends outdoors or long hours fishing, fabrics need sun protection and moisture management alongside softness, ease of movement and lasting wearing comfort.
translations.从披风的手感要求开始: Starting with the feel of a cape
translations.围绕客户提供的防晒披风，港翼已完成复合面料打样。在接近目标手感的基础上，进一步讨: GONYIK has developed laminated fabric samples around the feel of a customer-supplied sun cape. With the target feel as a starting point, the next discussion is about the functions required.
translations.面向防割、防刺需求，为防护服装、手套及需要加强防护的部位开发柔性材料。结合使用部: Flexible materials developed for cut and puncture protection in clothing, gloves and reinforced areas. Material and laminate choices depend on the protected area and movement requirements.
translations.围绕具体部位开发: Developed for the area being protected
translations.整片防护与局部加强，对材料厚度、柔软度和结构的要求不同。按具体样品与使用条件开展: Full-area protection and local reinforcement require different thicknesses, flexibility and constructions. Testing is based on specific samples and intended conditions.

translations.湖边穿着浅色披风的垂钓场景示意: Illustration of a light-colored cape worn while fishing by a lake
translations.柔性防护背心、手套与材料样片的应用示意: Application illustration of a flexible protective vest, gloves and fabric swatches
translations.面向户外服装、鞋材、软质箱包与柔性防护的面料应用。: Fabric applications for outdoor clothing, footwear, soft bags and luggage, and flexible protection.
translations.深蓝色户外冲锋衣与面料样片: Navy outdoor shell jacket and fabric swatches
translations.用于冲锋衣、夹克、滑雪服、水域披风等户外服装。围绕风雨、运动出汗和反复穿着，兼顾: For shell jackets, outdoor jackets, skiwear and waterside capes. Balance weather protection, moisture transfer and durability for active, repeated outdoor use.
translations.专业户外优先考虑 OTTER；更侧重日常穿着与柔软手感的款式，也可从 RAYO: Consider OTTER first for technical outdoor use; RAYO also offers options for styles that place greater emphasis on everyday comfort and a soft feel.
translations.浅灰绿色轻户外夹克与浅色防晒披风: Light sage outdoor jacket and an ivory sun cape
translations.用于轻户外夹克、防晒衣、垂钓披风等，适合日常出行、周末徒步与长时间户外活动。在所: For everyday outdoor jackets, sunwear and fishing capes, from daily outings to weekend walks and long hours outdoors. Combine the protection needed with moisture management, softness and wearing comfort.
translations.以 RAYO 为主要选材方向；对风雨防护或持续使用有更高要求的款式，可结合 OT: Start with RAYO; consider OTTER for styles with greater weather-protection demands or more sustained use.
translations.织物鞋面的户外鞋与鞋材样片: Outdoor shoes with textile uppers and a material swatch
translations.用于徒步鞋、户外休闲鞋等鞋面与内衬材料。根据穿着环境和鞋体结构，考虑防水透湿、反: For textile uppers and linings in hiking and outdoor casual footwear. Consider waterproof breathability, repeated flexing, abrasion, support and comfort around the intended conditions and shoe construction.
translations.以 OTTER 为选材方向，结合鞋面、内衬和复合结构开发。面料性能与成鞋表现分别: Develop upper, lining and laminate combinations with OTTER. Validate material performance separately from finished-footwear performance.
translations.织物背包与软质旅行箱: Woven textile backpack and soft-sided travel case
translations.用于背包、旅行袋与软质旅行箱。针对装载、搬运和户外使用中的摩擦、雨水及局部防护需: For backpacks, travel bags and soft-sided luggage. Select outer fabrics and reinforcements for abrasion, rain exposure and local protection during packing, handling and outdoor use.
translations.OTTER 用于外层防护，KAIS 用于需要防割或局部加强的部位。可按包体、底部: Use OTTER for outer protection and KAIS for cut-resistant or locally reinforced areas. Select materials separately for the body, base and load-bearing zones.
